description: This 1992 Porsche 911 Carrera 4 Cabriolet is an incredibly special example of the legendary 964 generation. With just 21k miles and essentially one-owner history from new until 2026, this is the type of air-cooled Porsche that has become nearly impossible to find. Low-mileage 964s are rare enough, but examples with this kind of long-term ownership and preservation are in another category entirely.Finished in timeless Black over Light Gray leather, it is powered by Porsche's naturally aspirated 3.6-liter air-cooled flat-six producing 247 horsepower, paired with a five-speed manual transmission. As a Carrera 4, it also features Porsche's sophisticated all-wheel-drive system, technology that was heavily influenced by the legendary 959.The 964 has become a favorite among Porsche enthusiasts and collectors for good reason. It retains the compact dimensions, unmistakable styling, incredible visibility and mechanical character that define a classic 911, while offering a level of refinement that makes these cars genuinely enjoyable to drive regularly. Drop the top, run the flat-six through the gears, and it delivers an experience that simply does not exist in a modern 911.Carrera 4 Cabriolets were produced in relatively limited numbers, and finding one today with only 21k miles and this type of provenance is exceptionally difficult. As air-cooled Porsche values have matured, originality, mileage, condition and ownership history have become increasingly important to collectors, making examples like this particularly desirable.The car was also recently serviced in preparation for sale and presents beautifully throughout. It is accompanied by its original window sticker showing an impressive $87,308 MSRP when new.For the collector looking for an exceptional 964 or the enthusiast who wants an air-cooled 911 special enough to preserve but still begging to be driven, this one checks all the boxes.Financing and nationwide delivery availableUp to 4 year warranties are availableIn business over 30 years Vantage Auto offers both unique inventory and fresh trade ins offered at wholesale to the public pricing. description: Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians.
